title: Cut per-item overhead in the windowed running min/max/mean generators
Running median window: avoid second bisect by tracking via sorted insertion index
Windowed running mean: use accumulate-difference pipeline instead of per-item generator with deque
Running median windowed: avoid the deque by deriving the evicted value from the source with a ring list
Windowed running min/max: skip enumerate and tuple storage by using a monotonic deque with a countdown expiry
Speed up _get_values in islice_extended / bucket path
Median window: skip the insort-then-delete step by using bisect-based replace when the window is full
Block-based (van Herk) sliding min/max via C-level accumulate/map instead of per-item deque loop
Rewrite _windowed_running_mean as a C-level pipeline: interleave value and negated lagged value, accumulate with add
set_partitions: hoist the block-size filter lambda and skip it when size limits are trivial
Optimise the running median windowed generator
bucket._get_values: bind cache deque and key lookup once per generator, avoid repeated dict lookup
Phase-split _running_median_windowed: fill phase, then fixed-size steady loop with precomputed parity and ring buffer
bucket._get_values: skip the validator call for already-cached keys by using a per-key seen set
Streamline collapse's per-item type checks and stack handling
Replace collapse's deque stack with a plain list stack in more.py
Windowed running mean: drop the deque by pairing the stream with a tee-lagged copy in a two-phase loop
Reduce generator overhead in set_partitions_helper and its genexpr
Replace try/next loop with a resumable for-loop over the parent iterator in bucket._get_values
Skip eviction work in _running_median_windowed until the window is full
Windowed running mean as C-level prefix-sum difference (accumulate + tee + islice + map) in _windowed_running_mean
Running min/max window: replace per-item index comparison with monotonic deque of values plus expiry counts
bucket._get_values: skip cache check for the value being scanned by caching per-value deque once
Fuse bucket._get_values cache lookup into a local deque, avoiding repeated dict indexing and attribute access
collapse: skip stack push/pop for flat input by consuming runs of non-iterable leaves with a tight inner loop
Replace tuple-and-index deque in windowed running min/max with a monotonic deque over a value deque and a counter
Replace insort/bisect/del median window with bounded-size fast path when window is small
Windowed running min/max: store values and indices in two parallel deques with a monotonic-index fast path
bucket._get_values: bind the cache deque once per call and drain it in an inner loop
Running min/max: drop the enumerate index tuples by storing indices in a parallel counter and evicting by count
Skip the cache-miss re-check in bucket._get_values by draining the cache with a local deque reference
Fuse windowed running min/max sliding-window deque into a monotonic queue storing indices with a parallel values deque
Running min/max window: replace per-item index tuples with a monotonic deque of values plus an eviction counter
bucket._get_values: bind the key function, validator and cache once per generator instead of per item
Avoid tuple allocation and index arithmetic in _windowed_running_min deque
Hoist attribute lookups and local bindings in bucket._get_values
Hoist attribute lookups in bucket._get_values into locals
Windowed running min/max: store parallel index and value deques, avoid tuple allocation
Same parallel-deque optimization for _windowed_running_max
Avoid tuple allocation and repeated indexing in windowed running min/max
Cache locals and avoid tuple indexing in _windowed_running_min/max
Windowed running mean: avoid len(window) calls by tracking the count and using local method bindings
Speed up _windowed_running_mean by hoisting method lookups and avoiding len() calls
Cache bound methods and drop len calls in windowed running mean
Speed up _windowed_running_mean with local bindings and a tracked length
bucket._get_values: bind cache deque and hoist attribute lookups
Optimize collapse inner loop: cache isinstance tuple and bound methods
Fast path for non-iterable ints in collapse using a type check
